title: Manner
descriptionFa: صفت‌ها و قیدهایی که می‌گن یه کار چطور انجام می‌شه: تند، آروم، خوب، بد.

words.example: This is a fast car. It goes very fast.
words.tipFa: fast هم صفته هم قید؛ fastly نداریم.

words.example: Let's take the slow train. It's cheaper.
Please speak slowly. I'm learning English.
words.tipFa: صفت + ly = قید: slow → slowly، quiet → quietly.

words.example: Come quickly! The bus is here.
The music is too loud. Please turn it down.
The children sang loudly at the party.
It's very quiet in the library.
The baby is sleeping, so please talk quietly.
She's a good driver. She drives well.
words.tipFa: قیدِ good می‌شه well، نه goodly.

words.example: He's a bad driver. He drives badly.

words.tipFa: the right way = راه درست. right معنی «راست» (جهت) هم داره.

words.example: Sorry, I think you have the wrong number.
words.tipFa: w اول خونده نمی‌شه: «رانگ». the wrong way = راه اشتباه.

words.example: The shop assistant smiled and spoke to us in a friendly way.
words.tipFa: friendly قید نداره (friendlily نداریم)، برای همین in a friendly way می‌گیم. ضدش: in an unfriendly way.

words.example: We were walking in the park when suddenly it started to rain.
She's very clever. She passed the exam easily.
He looked sadly at his broken phone.
My cat is behaving strangely today. Maybe she's ill.
